morphology.pattern_note: 英语专名，通常写作 Clayton；所列为常见英语读音，具体人物读法以本人为准。现代马来语中整词保留，不分析为马来语词根与词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 克莱顿：英语姓氏，也用作名字或地名；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An English surname, also used as a given name and a place name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai nama keluarga, nama individu atau nama tempat; rujukannya ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 这里的 noun 指专有名词。输入未提供人物或地点背景，不能指定某一位 Clayton。以下为姓名搭配示例，不代表已证实的高频固定搭配；定义为马来语释义，并非引自 DBP 的正式释文。姓氏来源参见 [Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 收录](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/clayton)。

etymology.historical_story: Clayton is an English habitational surname associated with several places bearing that name. Its historical elements are Old English clǣg, meaning clay, and tūn, meaning an enclosure or settlement. A landscape description thus became a place name and subsequently a family name. This history does not identify the particular Clayton intended in an isolated corpus token. [Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/clayton)
